verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark brand panel with a legible logo and reads left to right. However, the eyebrow and an orphaned divider sit under the logo, cut off from the headline. The body copy is jammed against the top edge, the CTA nearly touches the right edge, and the legal text is unreadably small. B is broken: a leftover dark rectangle cuts through the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow, so half of it sits on dark and half on cream. The white 'SOLSTICE' wordmark is on the cream background and almost invisible. The logo is also left floating apart from the centred stack.
